MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Beach Boys fit the melodic '60s pop I have been choosing through the Beatles and AM Gold, so their hits feel like a natural next listen.",
    "Peter, Paul and Mary and Jim Croce fit the warm vocals, harmonies, and storytelling I enjoy in Simon & Garfunkel, Melanie, and Jonathan Edwards.",
    "Eagles connect with my classic rock listening, and a familiar hits collection suits what I want today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Toby Keith's collection does not connect as closely with the older pop, folk, and classic rock I want right now; being a greatest-hits album alone is not enough.",
    "Queen and Journey fit some of my rock interests, but their bigger, more forceful songs appeal less than gentler folk and melodic '60s pop today.",
    "I cannot judge The Complete Hit Singles from its title alone because I do not know whose music it contains."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in greatest-hits collections seems to have counted too heavily compared with whose songs and what sound each collection contains.",
    "My classic rock listening seems to have been treated broadly, even though enjoying the Cars does not mean I want every kind of rock in the same session."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between my Simon & Garfunkel, Melanie, and Jonathan Edwards listening points toward warm storytelling and folk harmonies that matter especially today.",
    "An album can fit my taste without being something I choose now: the Righteous Brothers appeal, but I want something more upbeat, and ELO appeals even though I have already picked enough collections."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in familiar hits, but my strongest choices depend on melodic '60s pop, warm folk harmonies, and today's listening mood."
}
